training_source: complete settled normal synthetic reference trace after STARTUP_SETTLE_SAMPLES=80

required_metrics: false terminal actions in normal scenario

selection.rationale: Synthetic-only data do not justify a more complex model. A neural candidate must demonstrate a measured benefit on representative physical data under grouped/time-aware evaluation before promotion.

limitations: Synthetic reference only; not production predictive-maintenance accuracy.
Physical false-alarm rate, missed-fault rate, lead time, latency, memory, and drift remain evidence tasks.
ML cannot relax deterministic FPGA hard-safety rules.
